notes.title: v1.3 Update: New Options to Reduce Motion Sickness and Improve Performance
notes.notes:
In the v1.3 update, we’ve added the following settings:

Field of View

Motion Blur

Render Quality

If you experience motion sickness, try widening your Field of View and setting both Camera Shake and Motion Blur to 0 to help alleviate symptoms.

If performance feels sluggish on your machine, lower the Render Quality to 2. You can also set it to 0–1, but doing so will significantly reduce lighting and visual fidelity and may make some sections difficult to navigate.

For anyone who discontinued playing due to motion sickness or hardware limitations, we hope these new options will help you enjoy Kind() Station once more. If you still find the game unplayable, refunds are of course available—please follow the standard Steam refund process.

Thank you for your continued support of Kind() Station!

Studio 非

notes.title: Upcoming Update: Motion‐Sickness Mitigation & Performance Optimizations
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Kind() Station.

While we’re honored by all the positive feedback, we’ve also received reports of motion‐sickness in some sections and performance slowdowns in parts of certain stages. We’re actively exploring solutions to address these issues.

We sincerely apologize to anyone who was unable to continue playing because of these problems. If you can bear with us a little longer, we would be grateful if you’d give the game another try after our next update. We’ll share full details of the fixes as soon as they’re ready.

Please understand that, due to system limitations, we may not be able to eliminate every issue completely—but we remain committed to delivering the best possible experience. Thank you for your continued support.

Studio非
